string.text: Rookie jacket
Ordinary clothing of a beginner stalker. Protects its wearer from neither bullets nor anomalies, but is comfortable to wear. No built-in artifact containers.
"Wind of Freedom" suit

An extremely lightweight stalker suit made by the craftsmen of the Freedom faction. It is sewn from fabric treated with the "Horizon" compound, which greatly improves its protective properties under anomalous activity. Fitted with a built-in bulletproof vest and artifact containers.
"Sunrise" suit

This stalker suit, made by folk craftsmen, combines two-layer rubberized fabric with a plexiglass lining and a built-in bulletproof vest. Even though the vest can be pierced by a pistol bullet, the suit is very common thanks to its low price and wide range of upgrade options. Fitted with built-in artifact containers.
"SEVA" suit

Made at one of Kyiv's defense research institutes as an alternative to the stalkers' homemade suits. Although the built-in vest can only stop a pistol bullet, its protection from anomalous effects and radiation is rightly considered unmatched. Upgrade options and two built-in artifact containers have made this model popular among experienced stalkers.
SSP-99 "Ecologist" suit

The SSP-99 "Ecologist" chemical protection suit, built for work in the Zone. Used by scientific expeditions and the eco-stalkers who work with them. Built-in air filtration and conditioning system. Not designed for combat. Although all working material of anomalous origin is used only for laboratory research, the suit has five artifact containers. Fitted with a second-generation night vision device.
PS5-M "Universal Protection"

A modern model of the Duty suit. Better suited to stalker recruits who are used to relatively light suits. Unlike the PS3 series, it provides good protection from anomalous effects and can still stop a pistol bullet. Artifact containers can't be installed, but various auxiliary systems can.
CS-1 body armor
This body armor was developed for search operations in areas with low anomalous activity. Fairly high-quality materials have improved its wear resistance. Equipped with an artifact container.
CS-2 body armor

Reinforced body armor and a built-in gas mask provide decent protection from both bullets and anomalous effects compared to earlier models. Overall, however, the wearer's protection is far from sufficient for serious expeditions to the center of the Zone. Equipped with an artifact container.
CS-3a body armor

This was once the standard gear of Clear Sky assault squads. The destruction of the faction became a reminder to stalkers: even excellent gear can't guarantee safety inside the Zone's perimeter. This protective suit can not only stop a pistol bullet, but also provides good protection from anomalous effects. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
 
 %c[255,1,255,255]Used with the "Sphere T1I" helmet%c[default]
"Guardian of Freedom" suit

Essentially an army bulletproof vest reworked by the craftsmen of the Freedom faction: a successful combination of combat and anomaly protection. The built-in vest made of armor plates and multilayer Kevlar can stop more than just a pistol bullet. To protect against anomalous effects, the suit's fabric is impregnated with the "Sovereign" compound. Fitted with an artifact container.
"Berill-5M" body armor

A PSZ-5 series army bulletproof vest with beryllium coating, modified for work in the Zone. Designed for assault operations in areas with elevated background radiation, but not very effective under high anomalous activity. Can't be fitted with artifact containers.
 
 %c[255,1,255,255]Used with a steel helmet or the "Sphere B12"%c[default]
"Bulat" body armor

Modern army body armor for assault operations in areas of anomalous activity. Components: a PSZ-5a series heavy bulletproof vest, an anomaly protection coverall and a compensation suit. Provides excellent protection from bullets and shrapnel while staying comfortable and barely restricting the wearer's mobility. Can't be fitted with artifact containers.
 
 %c[255,1,255,255]Used with the "Sphere B12" helmet%c[default]
PSZ-9d "Duty Armor"

An early model of the Duty suit: a PSZ-5a series spec ops bulletproof vest adapted for use in the Zone. Can stop a rifle bullet, but it is very bulky and offers almost no protection from anomalous effects. Artifact containers can't be installed, but various auxiliary systems can.
 
 %c[255,1,255,255]Used with the "D-Sphere" helmet%c[default]
Exoskeleton

An experimental military exoskeleton prototype. It never went into mass production because of its extremely high cost. Even so, since it can greatly increase the wearer's mobility, it's in demand, so it's quietly produced in small batches. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
Gas mask

A standard gas mask designed to filter radioactive dust and toxic substances out of the air. Widely used by rookies and veterans of every faction alike, since nothing can replace it. Offers no protection from bullets, shrapnel or physical impact.
"Zaslon" helmet

A light helmet with a sealed visor, designed to protect the face from some anomalous effects. Judging by the technology, it was developed by the same defense research institute as the SEVA suit, presumably for use together with army protective suits.
Steel helmet
A standard army steel helmet. Offers no protection from anomalies or radiation, but can deflect a glancing bullet. In the Zone it was in demand only during the first clashes between factions.
"Sphere T1I" helmet

A tactical helmet with no markings of any kind. Designed to give a unit commander as much tactical information as possible once the right electronics are installed. It has a reinforced design and is also fitted with multilayer Kevlar protection, a respirator and a first-generation night vision device.
"Sphere B12" helmet

A fabric-covered aluminum-titanium helmet with pockets for steel armor plates and an armored mask. Usually supplied with PSZ-class spec ops body armor. Fairly popular in the Zone thanks to its respirator, built-in night vision device and good head protection. Electronics can be installed.
"SEVA" suit

Designed for research work in the Zone. Fitted with an outer insulating coating and a closed-cycle breathing system, which make it excellent protection from anomalous effects. However, its resistance to physical damage is low, so the wearer is very vulnerable to enemy fire. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
Army body armor
Army body armor made for assault operations. Provides excellent protection from jacketed bullets and shrapnel without reducing the wearer's mobility. Can be pierced by armor-piercing rounds.
Exoskeleton
The exoskeleton gives its wearer excellent protection from bullets and shrapnel, but noticeably reduces mobility. Can be pierced by armor-piercing rounds.
Leather jacket

Traditional bandit clothing: a leather jacket with sewn-in armor plates. Gives its wearer some protection from harmful effects, though still far from enough for the harsh conditions of the Zone. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
Bandit coat (brown)

A stylish bandit leather coat with sewn-in armor plates. Gives its wearer slightly more protection from harmful effects than a jacket, though still far from enough for the harsh conditions of the Zone. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
Bandit coat (black)

A stylish bandit leather coat with sewn-in armor plates. Gives its wearer slightly more protection from firearms and the Zone's harmful effects than a jacket, though still far from enough for the harsh conditions of the Zone. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
"Sunset" suit
A homemade variety of stalker suit. Essentially a light army bulletproof vest with extra protection from anomalous activity. Has a built-in artifact container.
Mercenary suit
A variety of stalker suit. The set includes a light bulletproof vest with extra protection from anomalous activity. Has a built-in artifact container.
Mercenary exoskeleton
A foreign-made exoskeleton model. An assault variant with increased bullet and blast protection and standard protection from anomalous effects.
Army bulletproof vest

A soldier's standard gear: a light army bulletproof vest. Protects fairly well against pistol bullets and shrapnel. Ineffective against anomalous and other effects. Artifact containers can't be installed.
PSZ-9Md "Universal Protection"

An excellent protective suit for the Zone. Stalkers value it for combining excellent anomaly protection with bullet protection. Components: a PSZ-9d coverall, a closed-cycle breathing system and a built-in anomalous field suppression system. Provides solid protection from bullets and shrapnel.
"Duty" exoskeleton
A special exoskeleton model for the Duty faction. Stronger materials have improved protection from physical damage and increased the suit's own wear resistance.
"Freedom" suit
A standard stalker suit made by the craftsmen of the Freedom faction. Has a built-in artifact container.
Freedom scientific suit

This armored suit was made by Freedom's craftsmen specifically for scientific research in the Zone. A closed-cycle breathing system and special impregnation of the materials provide excellent protection from radiation and harmful anomalous effects. However, the built-in vest can be pierced even by a pistol bullet, so the suit is no good for active combat.
"Freedom" exoskeleton
A special exoskeleton model for the Freedom faction. Lighter materials have reduced the suit's weight and increased its wear resistance.
"Assault" body armor

A lightweight version of the exoskeleton, made using its armor plates. There is no hydraulic system. The vest protects well against small arms, and the built-in gas mask and rubberized fabric coverall provide good protection from anomalous effects. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.
Monolith scientific suit

Like most of Monolith's creations, the technology is unknown. It has been established that it includes unknown materials. They are lighter than their counterparts and protect very well from radiation. Has a closed-cycle breathing system.
"Monolith-2" suit

The vest can stop a pistol bullet. The outer shell consists of two layers. Can protect its wearer from many anomalous effects and radiation. Has an artifact container.
Technology unknown.
 
 %c[255,1,255,255]Used with a gas mask%c[default]
"Monolith Assault" body armor

Standard gear of Monolith assault squads, made using exoskeleton armor plates. The vest protects well against small arms, and the built-in gas mask and coverall of unknown fabric provide good protection from anomalous effects. Fitted with a built-in artifact container.\nTechnology unknown.
"Monolith" exoskeleton
The Monolith faction's exoskeleton. Protects well from all kinds of effects. Wears out slowly.\nTechnology unknown.
SSP-99M suit

A high-quality modification of the SSP-99 "Ecologist" suit, with added torso protection from bullets and shrapnel. Designed to equip the guards of scientific expeditions. Effective protection from radiation and biological anomalies. Resistant to chemically aggressive environments and other effects harmful to the body. Although all working material of anomalous origin is used only for laboratory research, the suit has five artifact containers. Fitted with a second-generation night vision device.
"Sunrise" medical suit

A modified "Sunrise" suit. A combination of two-layer rubberized fabric with a plexiglass lining and a built-in bulletproof vest. Even though the vest can be pierced by a pistol bullet, the suit is very common thanks to its low price and wide range of upgrade options. Fitted with built-in artifact containers. Has healing properties.
